headline: A city built by a Greco-Bactrian king across the river from Taxila
text:
Sirkap is an archaeological site on the bank opposite Taxila, in Punjab, Pakistan.

The Greco-Bactrian king Demetrius built the city after invading the region around 180 BC. He founded an Indo-Greek kingdom that was to last until around 10 BC. Sirkap is also said to have been rebuilt by king Menander I.
